dedupe_keys.name: china crop system greenhouse gas emissions 1978 2016

description: This Figshare collection reports China's cropping-system greenhouse gas emissions from 1978 through 2016 by agricultural activity and province. Member CSV files cover rice cultivation, fertiliser and pesticide production, machinery use, crop-residue burning and land change, with point estimates and an uncertainty table. Agricultural, irrigation or rural-energy simulations can use these accounts to compare historical emissions under alternative crop-system assumptions. They are factor-based inventories, not direct measurements at each farm. The province and activity tables overlap and should not be summed without checking their accounting structure. All eleven own collection members state CC0, although the collection DOI registry states CC BY 4.0; this draft uses the individual data-item rights. I read member metadata and the article without downloading CSVs. The related rice-cultivation sample code has its own item and is reviewed separately. No exact catalogue coverage was found.
